channel.title: Sound on Sound - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Sound on Sound (soundonsound.com)

item.title: Milab to restart production
item.description: milab_vip-60.jpg Iconic Swedish mic manufacturer back in action Legendary Swedish microphone manufacturer Milab have announced that production is now fully underway, and microphones are leaving their factory once again!

item.title: MPG announce new Impact Award
item.description: mpg_awards_war_child_help2.jpg Presented to War Child UK’s HELP(2) project The MPG (Music Producers Guild) have announced the launch of a brand-new honour that will recognise music projects that deliver meaningful social and cultural impact through the craft and collaboration of music production.

item.title: Mix Rescue: Ian Shepherd Video
item.description: MixR_01.jpg How much difference should mastering make? To accompany his words in SOS April 2026's Mix Rescue, Ian Shepherd has created a video where he demonstrates the difference between new and original masters of the same album.

item.title: Eduardo Tarilonte’s Ancient ERA Persia from Best Service
item.description: best_service_ancient_era.jpg Microtuning support for Arabic, Persian & Turkish scales The latest release from Best Service brings together a selection of string, wind and percussion instruments that promise to take users “into the sound worlds of past civilizations”.

item.title: VSL update Synchron Woodwinds & Strings
item.description: vsl_synchron_special_woodwinds.jpg Free updates now available Synchron Woodwinds, Synchron Strings Pro and Synchron Duality Strings (Colors) have just gained some new capabilities, and the updates come alongside a new limited-time promotion across VSL's woodwind libraries.

item.title: BOOM Library release Seasons of Earth: European Autumn
item.description: boom_library_seasons_of_earth_european_autumn.jpg Made entirely from real natural recordings The latest release from BOOM Library comes packed with production-ready exterior ambiences that capture the distinct acoustic character of autumn.

item.title: Klang.io launch Transcription Studio
item.description: klangio_transcription_studio.jpeg Transcribe sheets, tabs or MIDI from audio files Transcription Studio can run as a DAW plug-in or standalone application, and promises to make it easier than ever for professional and hobbyist musicians alike to document and communicate even the most complex of musical ideas.

item.title: Warm Audio | SOS Podcast
item.description: bryce_young_warm_audio_header.jpg Behind The Brand Bryce Young, founder and president of Warm Audio discusses how the company began and how it quickly built a reputation for producing affordable studio gear inspired by classic vintage designs. Published March 2026 Music Business SOS PODCASTSAudio InterfacesMicrophones / MikingSignal Processors > Compressors

item.title: ALM/Busy Circuits announce the Quaid Gigaslope & FMco
item.description: alm_busy_circuits_quaid_gigaslope.jpg Latest Eurorack modules revealed ALM/Busy Circuits' range of Eurorack modules has just been expanded with a versatile new modulation tool and a compact FM synth voice.

item.title: Akai Pro unveil the MPC Sample
item.description: akai_pro_mpc_sample.jpg Smallest, most affordable MPC to date The MPC Sample draws its inspiration from the likes of the MPC60, and allows users to sample, chop and arrange beats anywhere with no computer required.
